protocol.reproducibility_scope: RNG-exact continuation on the saved runtime; bitwise identity is not guaranteed across devices or dependency builds

training_curriculum.checkpoint_selection: segment evaluation is training-only diagnostic; fixed full-course evaluation remains the checkpoint-selection signal

segment_evaluation.start_state: k4 touchdown altitude 5-18 with pad offset <=20, |vx|<=3, vy 0-6, |tilt|<=0.08, |rate|<=0.05; k3/k2/k1 approach altitude 30-100/50-200/100-500 with pad offset <=35, |vx|<=6, vy 2-18, |tilt|<=0.18, |rate|<=0.25; k0 canonical x=500, y=120, vy=rate=0, fuel=1, elapsed=0 with seeded |vx|<=15 and |tilt|<=0.15; rehearsals preserve altitude-derived elapsed time and fuel

protocol.training_start_distribution: Performance-gated reverse altitude curriculum: begin with 100% touchdown rehearsals at k4 (5-18 units above the pad); unlock low k3 (30-100), overlapping k2 (50-200), high k1 (100-500), then canonical k0 descents after one >=90% fixed 20-start k4 evaluation and >=75% at each harder frontier; thereafter the active frontier receives 50% of resets and mastered easier frontiers uniformly share the remainder
